items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion in combined market cap after midterms
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国中期选举后特斯拉与SpaceX合计市值蒸发超过4200亿美元，对kcn持有的SpaceX相关标的构成直接估值压力。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Sales Are ‘Exploding’—and Forecasts Revenue Twice Wall Street’s Estimate
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk称SpaceX销售正在“爆发”，并预计收入将达到华尔街估计的两倍，对kcn持有的SpaceX标的是强正面信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX is competing for NASA’s $10 billion in contracts to build a moon base
items.summary_cn: 据报道，SpaceX正竞逐NASA价值100亿美元的月球基地建设合同，潜在订单将直接影响kcn持有的SpaceX敞口。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Says Tesla's Cybertruck Backlog Is Too Big To Clear Before Production Ends — Orders Extra Shift
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk称特斯拉Cybertruck订单积压庞大到停产后仍无法消化，并安排额外班次生产以满足需求。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says Tesla Cybercab future is ‘obvious to anyone with eyes and a brain’
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk认为特斯拉Cybercab的未来显而易见，继续为Robotaxi商业化路线背书。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry trims Caterpillar bearish bet after puts nearly quadruple (CAT:NYSE)
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry在卡特彼勒看跌期权收益接近四倍后削减了CAT空头头寸，兑现盈利但其估值偏空观点仍受市场关注。

items.summary_cn: 特朗普称卡塔尔等海湾国家支持延续对伊朗的海上封锁和“铁门行动”，显示中东冲突与能源供应风险仍高。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am proud to announce that David MacNeil, the GREAT American entrepreneur and founder of WeatherTech, will be the Special Envoy for Manufacturing! David has built an incredible American company that makes outstanding products, RIGHT HERE IN THE U.S.A. He knows how to create jobs, bring Manufacturing back home, and put America First. Together, we will bring back American jobs, strengthen our factories, and make sure that future products are MADE IN AMERICA. Congratulations David — Your unparalleled expertise is vitally needed! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普任命WeatherTech创始人David MacNeil为制造业特使，释放支持美国制造业回流和扩大本土就业的政策信号。
